auth.BROKER_DESK_AUTH_PROVIDER: optional server/runtime compatibility selector; must agree with mode if set
auth.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL: browser and server public project URL; not a secret
auth.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY: browser and server public publishable key; not a service-role secret
auth.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY: server-only; only for explicitly approved Auth admin lifecycle actions, never client or browser

dataAndWorker.DATA_DRIVER: server/runtime; explicit postgres is recommended in Preview
dataAndWorker.DATABASE_URL: server-only application pool; restricted runtime role
dataAndWorker.DATABASE_ADMIN_URL: server-only admin/worker repository path; not a page credential
dataAndWorker.BROKER_DESK_DEPLOYMENT_ENV: server/runtime; preview or staging to keep Preview processing synchronous
dataAndWorker.BROKER_DESK_IMPORT_WORKER_TOKEN: server-only internal drain token, only when worker validation is approved
dataAndWorker.CRON_SECRET: server-only route secret for manual cron endpoint; no Vercel Cron is configured
dataAndWorker.BROKER_DESK_IMPORT_WORKER_ENABLED: formal-production worker gate only; not required for Preview sync mode
dataAndWorker.BROKER_DESK_IMPORT_WORKER_SCHEDULE: formal-production worker gate only; do not carry a per-minute Cron into Tokyo Preview

migrationOnly.DATABASE_MIGRATION_CA_CERT_PATH: migration runner CA input only; does not configure DATABASE_URL or DATABASE_ADMIN_URL

runtimeVariables.tlsObservation: src/lib/database-connection.ts normalizes sslmode prefer/require/verify-ca to verify-full, but src/lib/data.postgres.ts then supplies rejectUnauthorized:false for supabase.co URLs. The effective runtime behavior must be treated as not verified for CA validation until corrected; no deployment is authorized in this turn.
